verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the GitHub README, which says you can get started by 'choosing a template' and then git push to deploy. That confirms templates exist as an onboarding path, but nothing describes a one-click flow or a catalog of starters for common use cases. Missing for 10: documentation of a template/starter gallery, one-click deploy-button flow, coverage of common use cases (e.g. e-commerce, AI, blog), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
